answer: Entry is sold by auction. Each epoch offers a few slots, and applicants bid copper coins for one. A quartz clock opens bidding at one instant for all, and the winning bid is locked as a bond for twenty epochs. Forging one hundred fakes means one hundred winning bids: fifty copper a slot, five thousand copper locked up front, while fakes earn nothing. An honest agent pays once, earns a pearl credential after twenty epochs, and gets it back.
